provenance.source: Original project-authored valid acyclic carbon-tree recipe; no third-party molecular rows

transformation.graph: One central C=C; each endpoint has two single-bonded identical balanced binary carbon subtrees of the declared depth. Every atom obeys ordinary carbon valence.
transformation.permutation: Rotate atom indices by variant*n//8; reverse the rotated order for odd variants. Retain every record, including equivalent permutations.
transformation.coordinates: x=index/2; y=(index%7)/4; z=0, in angstrom; 2D conformer
transformation.producer: Pinned existing RDKit 2026.09.1; MolToMolBlock(forceV3000=True); no input filtering.

redistribution.rationale: New synthetic project-authored graphs and recipe under project dual license

minimization: Eight fixed depths cross the 32-visited-atom storage boundary and reach 1022 atoms; eight declared atom permutations check order sensitivity. All 64 records retained. No biological, physical or toolkit-wide representativeness is claimed.

oracle.native_source_version: 1.1.4 plus thirteen accepted source candidates versus frozen ring-queue prototype
oracle.settings: SanitizeMol; canonical isomeric MolToSmiles; strict sanitized MolFromMolBlock(removeHs=False); exact coordinates and names; native snapshot/dump repeats=1 expected=64

expected.status: Every source snapshot/rewrite byte-identical; every source canonical and rewritten graph equals generated RDKit graph; names and exact 2D coordinates preserved
expected.scope: Separate post-hoc exploratory source-only diagnostic; never Open Babel ranking or replacement of original matrices
